newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $103.50/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $103.50/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Thursday sold at $103.00 to $103.50 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume, steady with Wednesday's brisk activity, market sources said.
About 2,500 head sold, with no reported sales on a live basis. Further bids at $103.00 to $103.50 were being passed by owners pricing cattle at $104.00, they said.
Week-to-date sales through Wednesday were put at 50,500 head following that day's trade of 30,600, USDA said.
This week's showlist was estimated near 75,000 head, the market sources said.
